metadata.disclaimer: This is a MODEL over an ASSUMED event profile, not a measurement. Totals integrate measured per-op gas (Experiment A steady-state append marginals + gas_benchmark.json birth/transfer costs) across the canonical profile. Gas is relative on-chain work, not fiat (RESEARCH_AUDIT.md §4.1). The profile is an assumption; the +/-50% band varies recurring event frequency.
